title: Recording decisions
summary: Practice a concise decision record that preserves context without turning routine work into bureaucracy.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

items: The source documents or discussion that informed it

blocks.text: A good internal record should make sense to a colleague who was not present. It should be concise enough to scan and complete enough to avoid reconstructing the decision from scattered messages.
